legacy_protection.strict_configuration: Separate ST schema, no pretending changed objectives are old C1 FULL

ModelInputs.current_images: B lists of 3 original current views, unchanged preprocessing
ModelInputs.current_state: float32 B,1,4 normalized original ego delta x/y/sin/cos
ModelInputs.navigation: original text prompt or validated navigation enum
ModelInputs.history_images: optional B,2,3 real images, times -1.0,-0.5 only
ModelInputs.history_valid: bool B,2,3 based only on available current/past files
ModelInputs.history_times_s: float B,2 physical timestamps verified against each scene t0

TrainingTargets.current_dense_features: detached B,3,H,W,C (native grid and optional fixed PCA metadata)

SampledRequests.built: once per full optimizer batch before microbatch slicing, independently of label success
SampledRequests.patch_indices: B,3,K valid native-grid addresses sampled uniformly with own RNG; same addresses in paired future endpoints
SampledRequests.physical_times_s: B,2 adjacent pair from (.5,1),(1,2),(2,4) using dedicated recoverable RNG

SparseFeatureReadout.output: B,Q,C with Q independent of Nw
SparseFeatureReadout.reuse: DINOFeatureHead coordinate/time/view encoders and CrossReadout; memory projection once per scene forward, flatten requested times/positions
constraints: No target tensor enters query construction except requested fixed coordinates/time chosen independently of validity
Cross-attention from output queries to all W; no query geometry implies physical correspondence of W
Use same new head initialization in all matching groups; share current/future predictor where declared

LossContract.current: FP32 squared error / complete optimizer-batch valid element count
LossContract.future: 0.5*(FP32 MSE at a / valid_a + FP32 MSE at b / valid_b)
LossContract.delta: MSE((pred_b-pred_a)-(target_b-target_a)) / paired-valid elements; no L2 or per-token delta norm
LossContract.distributed: local numerator * world_size / global denominator, one reduction per complete optimizer batch, no extra accumulation mean
LossContract.all_invalid: Graph-connected zero; same collective order; report counts
LossContract.repeat: FM repeat8 only; no auxiliary multiplication

CheckpointMigration.source_load: Reconstruct all FP32 master tensors and strict-load original S0 before mapping
CheckpointMigration.W_expansion: Explicit per-view old48->new96 row map, new rows seeded independently; no claim same initial function after longer W sequence
CheckpointMigration.readout: Enumerate changed/new/dropped auxiliary keys; PCA output map or explicit new output initialization recorded
CheckpointMigration.target_load: strict=True against complete transformed state, never blanket strict=False
CheckpointMigration.training_state: new experiment fresh optimizer/schedule; same-run resume strict native model/master/optimizer/RNG/consumed-cursor restoration

OwnerBoundary.FlowPolicy: Separate original DiT/FPO code; reuse H_A only on frozen-Qwen C line

evidence.DINO_Foresight: Official SHAd98f765d2b743ec90fb38bc657a39c07c7ca4ab0; standardized channels then non-whiten PCA; not equivalent to raw-centered PCA
evidence.sparse_and_delta_claim: New project adaptation supported by existing local coordinate-time cross-readout, not an established DINO-Foresight result
